visual.title: One point carries both coordinates
visual.caption: A point P on the unit circle has coordinates (cos θ, sin θ). The angle turns counterclockwise from the positive x-axis, and the same angle marks the sine and cosine values on the graph below. Drag P or change the angle: the point, the two coordinates and the graph move together.

predict.question: At θ = 90°, where is P and what are its coordinates?
options: P is (0, 1), so cos θ = 0 and sin θ = 1
P is (1, 0), so cos θ = 1 and sin θ = 0
P leaves the unit circle because the angle is vertical
predict.explain: A quarter turn reaches the top of the unit circle. The x-coordinate is 0, so cos 90° = 0, and the y-coordinate is 1, so sin 90° = 1. Every point stays on x² + y² = 1.
